page_text_ocr_zh:
神奇
种子店
文/图：[日]宫西达也
翻译：林真美
有一天，小猪咚咚咚、咚咚咚地走在原野上，
突然，它发现了一家神奇种子店。
“狗獾叔叔，神奇种子到底有多神奇啊？”
北京联合出版公司
page_text_en:
Magic
Seed Shop
Text & Illustrations: [Japan] Tatsuya Miyazawa
Translated by: Lin Zhenmei
One day, the little pig trotted, trotted, trotted across the meadow,
and suddenly, it discovered a magic seed shop.
"Uncle Badger, just how magical are the magic seeds?"
Beijing United Publishing Company
summary_zh: 小猪在原野上行走时，发现了一家名为“神奇种子店”的小店，并好奇地向店里的狗獾叔叔询问神奇种子的神奇之处。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“这里的种子，可神奇了。
小猪，你将这又白又冰凉的种子埋进土里，看看会怎样？
“哇，这种子真的是又白又冰凉。”
小猪一边说，一边将种子埋进土里。
于是，狗獾叔叔——
page_text_en:
"These seeds are magical.
Little pig, bury this white and cool seed in the soil and see what happens?
"Wow, this seed is really white and cool."
The little pig said, while burying the seed in the soil.
Then, Uncle Badger—
summary_zh: 小猪在神奇种子店向狗獾叔叔询问种子的神奇之处，狗獾叔叔建议他将种子埋进土里，小猪照做后，故事即将展开。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来，
中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来中兹……”
念完怪里怪气的咒语之后——
一棵树扭啊扭、扭啊扭地
长出来了——
page_text_en:
"Zhong zi, zhong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai,
Zhong zi, zhong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai zhong zi……"
After reciting the strange and odd incantation——
A tree twisted and twisted, twisted and twisted,
Grew out——
summary_zh: 小猪在狗獾叔叔的指导下念出咒语，随后一棵树在原地扭动着长了出来。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“哇！雪人！”
“小猪，又白又冰凉的种子
是会长出雪人的种子哦！”
page_text_en:
"Wow! Snowmen!"
"Piggy, these white and icy seeds
are seeds that grow snowmen!"
summary_zh: 小猪和狗獾叔叔站在一棵结满雪人果实的树下，小猪惊喜地发现树上长满了雪人，狗獾叔叔解释这是由又白又冰凉的种子长出来的。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“好啦，小猪，接下来这个
像圆圆一样的种子也很神奇哦！
”
狗獾叔叔一说完，就将种子埋进土里。
并且，开始念着——

“中兹，中兹，棵玉顾吃乌来，
中兹，中兹，棵宝顾吃乌来中兹……”
狗獾叔叔念完怪里怪气的咒语之后，
一棵树扭啊扭、扭啊扭地长出来了——
page_text_en:
"Alright, little pig, the next one—
this round seed is also very magical!"
After the badger uncle finished speaking, he buried the seed in the soil.
And then, he began chanting—

"Zong zi, zong zi, ke yu gu chi wu lai,
Zong zi, zong zi, ke bao gu chi wu lai zong zi..."
After the badger uncle finished chanting the strange incantation,
a tree twisted and twisted, growing up—
summary_zh: 狗獾叔叔向小猪展示另一颗神奇种子，并将其埋入土中，随后念出咒语，一棵树在原地扭动着长了出来。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“哇！甜甜圈！
“小猪，像圈圈一样的种子
是会长出甜甜圈的种子哦！”
page_text_en:
"Wow! Doughnuts!"
"Piglet, seeds that look like rings
are seeds that grow doughnuts!"
summary_zh: 小猪和狗獾叔叔站在一棵结满甜甜圈果实的树下，小猪惊喜地发现树上长满了甜甜圈，狗獾叔叔解释这是由像圈圈一样的种子长出来的。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“接下来的神奇种子
是有很多颜色的轻飘飘种子哦！
小猪，你种种看。”
小猪开心地将种子埋进土里，
狗獾叔叔又开始念起咒语来了——

“中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来，
中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来中兹……”
念完怪里怪气的咒语之后，
一棵树扭啊扭、扭啊扭地长出来了——
page_text_en:
"The next magical seed
is a light, fluffy seed with many colors!
Little pig, you try planting it."
The little pig happily buried the seed in the soil,
and Uncle Badger began reciting the spell again—

"Zongzi, zongzi, ke wai dian chi wu lai,
Zongzi, zongzi, ke wai dian chi wu lai zongzi..."
After finishing the strange-sounding spell,
a tree twisted and twisted, growing up—
summary_zh: 狗獾叔叔向小猪展示一颗多色轻飘飘的神奇种子，小猪将其种下后，狗獾叔叔念出咒语，一棵树在原地扭动着长了出来。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“哇！气球！”
“小猪，有很多颜色的轻飘飘种子
是会长出气球的种子哦！”
page_text_en:
"Wow! Balloons!"
"Piggy, these colorful, light-as-air seeds
are the kind that grow into balloons!"
summary_zh: 小猪和狗獾叔叔站在一棵结满彩色气球的树下，小猪惊喜地发现树上长满了气球，狗獾叔叔解释这是由多色轻飘飘的种子长出来的。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“小猪，接下来的神奇种子是……”
狗獾叔叔正在犹豫，小猪就擅自说道：
“叔叔，我来种这全都是洞的种子吧！”
说完，就将种子埋进土里。
而且还念起咒语来——

“中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来，
中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来中兹……”
他刚一念完，
“糟、糟、糟了……”狗獾叔叔吓得全身发抖，
一棵树扭啊扭、扭啊扭地长出来了。
page_text_en:
"Piglet, the next magical seed is..."
The badger uncle was hesitating, but Piglet spoke up: 
"Uncle, I'll plant this seed full of holes!"
He then buried the seed in the soil.
And started chanting the spell—

"Zong zi, zong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai,
Zong zi, zong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai zong zi..."
As soon as he finished,
"Oh no, oh no, oh no..." the badger uncle trembled with fear,
A tree twisted and twisted, growing right out of the ground.
summary_zh: 小猪主动要求种植一颗全都是洞的种子，并念出咒语，狗獾叔叔在旁紧张地观察，随后一棵树扭动着长了出来。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“哇——！
“这、这是会长出蜂窝的种子啊，
小猪，快逃！”，
page_text_en:
"Wow——!
"This... this is a seed that grows beehives,
Little Pig, run away!"
summary_zh: 小猪和狗獾叔叔站在一棵结满蜂窝的树下，树上飞满了蜜蜂，狗獾叔叔惊慌地喊小猪快逃。

page_text_ocr_zh:
逃离蜜蜂群以后，他们又折回原地。
“狗獾叔叔，会长出蜂窝的种子我不要，
至于其他的种子，请全都给我吧！”，

听小猪这么说，狗獾叔叔回答：
“那我再加送一样种子给你。
当你遇到困难时，只要种下这个种子，
就会有意想不到的事发生哦！”
狗獾叔叔说完，把一个表面粗糙的
特大号种子交到小猪的手上。

“狗獾叔叔，谢谢你。”
小猪说完，便兴高采烈地走了。
“嘻嘻嘻……现在我要将甜甜圈的种子埋到土里，
然后就有许多好吃的甜甜圈啦！”
就在这时，从树荫下——
page_text_en:
After escaping the swarm of bees, they returned to the original spot.
"Uncle Badger, I don't want the seed that grows beehives,
but please give me all the other seeds!"

Hearing the piglet say this, Uncle Badger replied:
"Then I'll give you one more seed.
When you're in trouble, just plant this seed,
something unexpected will happen!"
After saying this, Uncle Badger handed the piglet a large, rough-textured seed.

"Thank you, Uncle Badger."
The piglet said, then happily walked away.
"Hehehe... Now I'm going to plant the donut seed in the soil,
and then I'll have lots of delicious donuts!"
Just then, from under the tree shade —
summary_zh: 小猪在逃离蜜蜂群后，向狗獾叔叔索要所有其他种子，狗獾叔叔赠予他一颗特大号的神秘种子。小猪感谢后兴高采烈地离开，准备种植甜甜圈种子，但故事在树荫下戛然而止。

page_text_ocr_zh:
跳出来一只大灰狼，
“好吃的甜甜圈算什么，
本大爷想吃的是又肥又嫩的小猪啊！嘿嘿嘿……”

“糟了！得想想办法啊！”
小猪赶忙将又白又冰凉的种子
埋进土里，并念上咒语：
“中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来，
中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来中兹……”
于是，
一棵树扭啊扭、扭啊扭地长出来了——
page_text_en:
A big gray wolf jumped out,
"What's the point of delicious donuts?
I want to eat a fat and tender little pig! Hehehe..."

"Oh no! I need to think of something!"
The little pig quickly buried the white and icy seed
in the soil and chanted the spell:
"Zong zi, zong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai,
Zong zi, zong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai zong zi..."
Then,
a tree twisted and twisted, growing up—
summary_zh: 大灰狼出现并想吃掉小猪，小猪慌忙将一颗又白又冰凉的种子埋入土中并念咒语，一棵树开始扭动着生长。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“怪了……我明明看到……
这附近有一只小猪啊……？”

大灰狼东张西望，四下搜寻，
“怎、怎、怎么回事？
这里怎么有个雪人？”
大灰狼盯着雪人直看，这时——

雪人开始滴滴答答地融化，
小猪的手和尾巴露了出来。
“啊……糟、糟了！
怎么办？啊，有、有了！”
page_text_en:
"Strange... I clearly saw... 
there's a little pig nearby...?"

The big gray wolf looked around, searching everywhere, 
"What, what, what's going on? 
Why is there a snowman here?" 
The big gray wolf stared at the snowman, when suddenly—

The snowman began to melt, drip by drip, 
and the pig's hands and tail appeared. 
"Oh... trouble, trouble! 
What should I do? Ah, I've got it!"
summary_zh: 大灰狼发现树下有一个雪人，感到困惑，随后雪人开始融化，露出小猪的手和尾巴，小猪惊慌中想到办法。

page_text_ocr_zh:
骨碌骨碌骨碌……
小猪雪人顺势滚着逃走了。
之后，小猪说：
“看我的，接下来是这个轻飘飘的种子。”
“中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来，
中兹，中兹，棵歪颠吃乌来中兹……”
小猪种下种子，念完咒语。
于是，
一棵树扭啊扭、扭啊扭地长出来了——
这是一棵长满气球的树。
飘啊飘，飘啊飘……
“太棒了！”
不过——
page_text_en:
Roll, roll, roll...
The pig snowman rolled away.
Then, the pig said:
"Watch this, next is this light and floaty seed."
"Zong zi, zong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai,
Zong zi, zong zi, ke wai dian chi wu lai zong zi..."
The pig planted the seed and finished the spell.
Then,
a tree twisted and twisted, growing up—
This is a tree full of balloons.
Floating, floating...
"Amazing!"
But—
summary_zh: 小猪在逃离大灰狼后，种下一颗轻飘飘的种子，长出一棵结满气球的树，小猪兴奋地被气球带向空中，但故事在‘不过——’处戛然而止。

page_text_ocr_zh:
大灰狼也抓了一把气球，
追了上去。

“不、不、不行了……”
小猪正想投降，突然灵机一动。
“对了！狗獾叔叔给的
那个救急用的种子，
现在正好派上用场。”
小猪降落到地面之后——

将又大又粗糙的种子埋进土里，
“中兹，中兹，榛宝颠吃乌来，
中兹，中兹，榛宝颠吃乌来中兹……”
小猪念完了咒语。
可是——

“嘿嘿嘿……我抓到你了。”
大灰狼张开大口，要将小猪一口吞下去。
就在这时，
一棵树扭啊扭、扭啊扭地长出来了——
page_text_en:
The big bad wolf grabbed a bunch of balloons and chased after him.

"No, no, I can't..."
Little Pig was about to give up, but suddenly had an idea.
"Ah! The emergency seed that Uncle Badger gave me—
this is just the right time to use it."
After Little Pig landed on the ground—

He buried the big, rough seed in the soil,
"Zongzi, zongzi, Zhen Bao Dian Chi Wu Lai,
Zongzi, zongzi, Zhen Bao Dian Chi Wu Lai Zongzi..."
Little Pig finished the spell.
But then—

"Hehehe... I've got you!"
The big bad wolf opened his mouth wide, ready to swallow Little Pig whole.
Just then,
a tree twisted and twisted, growing up—
summary_zh: 小猪被大灰狼追捕，用气球短暂逃脱后落地，紧急种下一颗种子并念咒语，但大灰狼即将抓住他时，一棵树开始扭动生长。

page_text_ocr_zh:
嗷——！
“原、原、原来是
会长出恐龙的种子啊！”
小猪好惊讶。
大灰狼更是吓得说不出话来。
“救命啊——”
在发出一声惨叫后，
大灰狼就逃之夭夭了。
page_text_en:
Roar——!
"O-oh, it's a seed that grows dinosaurs!"
Little Pig is very surprised.
The Big Bad Wolf is so scared he can't speak.
"Help!"
After letting out a scream,
the Big Bad Wolf runs away.
summary_zh: 小猪种下种子后长出一只恐龙，大灰狼被吓到惊叫逃走。

page_text_ocr_zh:
小猪松了一口气。
“神奇的种子真是不可思议，
虽然我也吓了一大跳……
不过，我还是比较喜欢
普普通通会开花的种子啊！呵呵呵……”
小猪说着说着笑了起来。
page_text_en:
The little pig sighed in relief.
"The magical seeds are truly incredible,
although I was scared out of my wits...
Still, I prefer ordinary seeds that bloom into flowers! Hehehe..."
The little pig said, laughing.
summary_zh: 小猪在恐龙吓跑大灰狼后松了一口气，表示虽然种子神奇，但他更喜欢会开花的普通种子，并开心地笑了起来。
